Composition rights
Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies. Inferred, not documented

Liszt died in 1886. This is a term calculation, not worldwide clearance of every edition.

[1]
Recording rights
Territorial EU public-domain basis for the historical commercial Odeon 76565 issue under the programme’s pre-1963 recording rule. Documented

The reissue’s 1912/3 chronology and the uploader’s narrower March 1913 attribution identify the historical issue period, not an independently established first-publication date. US first-publication evidence and US status are not established. Archive’s Public Domain Mark is not a rightsholder release; the CD’s separate 1993 compilation rights are not represented as a new historical recording date.
